title: Potential type error
detail: The `_add_cookies_to_wsgi` method is called with `request.environ`, but `request` is a `Request` object. This could lead to a type error if `request` is not a `WSGIEnvironment`. The same applies to lines 997, 1249.

title: Potential type error
detail: The `environ` parameter can now be a `Request` object, but the method does not handle this case correctly. If `environ` is a `Request`, it will be treated as a `WSGIEnvironment`, which could lead to unexpected behavior. The same applies to line 294.

title: OSError instead of PermissionError
detail: The code now catches all OSError, which is too broad and can hide other important errors. The same applies to line 508.
